import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders
import os

# Build the email
msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = "noreply@workspace.local"
msg["To"] = "bob@example.com"
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Report (PDF)"

body = "Hi Bob,\\n\\nPlease find the customer report attached as a PDF.\\n\\nBest regards"
msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

# Attach the PDF
pdf_path = "output/customer_report.pdf"
with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", f"attachment; filename=customer_report.pdf")
    msg.attach(part)

# Attempt to send via localhost SMTP (best-effort in sandbox)

    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25, timeout=5) as server:
        server.sendmail(msg["From"], [msg["To"]], msg.as_string())
    print("Email sent successfully to bob@example.com")
except Exception as e:
    # No local SMTP server — save the .eml so the user can verify
    eml_path = "output/customer_report_email.eml"
    with open(eml_path, "w") as ef:
        ef.write(msg.as_string())
    print(f"No SMTP server available in sandbox. Email saved as {eml_path}")
    print(f"Recipient: bob@example.com | Attachment: customer_report.pdf ({os.path.getsize(pdf_path)} bytes)")
'''
